content:
Weekday working:
\[
W=4(F+I)=4(3+1)=16\text{ hours/day}
\]
so \(5\cdot 16=80\) hours.

Weekend working:
\[
F=3W \Rightarrow W=F/3=3/3=1\text{ hour/day}
\]
so \(2\cdot 1=2\) hours.

Total working = \(80+2=82\) hours.

Twitter: \(2\cdot 2=4\) hours.  
Instagram: \(5\cdot 1=5\) hours.

Including Twitter and Instagram:
\[
82+4+5=91
\]

\boxed{91}
